en.t: I leaned against the pine tree.

units.source_text: 这濡湿了的冰凉的树身，吸引了我。

en.t: The wet, cold trunk drew me in.

units.source_text: 这种感觉，这种冰凉，使我感到它就是我。

en.t: This sensation, this coldness, made me feel that it was myself.

units.source_text: 世界以其本来的形态停止下来，也失去了欲望，我心满意足了。

en.t: The world stopped in its original form, desire was lost as well, and I was completely content.
